parent_RUN13.optical_quality_rule: S2 SCL in {4,5}, all reflectance bands non-nodata; L8 QA_PIXEL bits 0..5 and 7 clear, QA_RADSAT==0, all bands non-nodata. Nearest-neighbour quality projection, never bilinear classes. Four-scene intersection. This is a quality screen, not stability evidence.
parent_RUN13.comparison_support: Intersection of all three epochs in every completed variant AND the original common support. Fixed masks and sample coordinates; no method-specific comparison supports.
limitations: All reference candidates are mostly vegetated; unseen ground/canopy change may be absorbed into registration.
Optical dates differ from DEM dates, especially July vs September 2024; no season correction or radiometric sensor harmonization.
H_N and H_W are spatially withheld candidate surfaces, not external surveyed controls.
W_SLUMP is a repeatable observation window, not the entire Batagay slump; do not compare its volume/area to a published full-slump value.
Independent-pair cycle closure detects internal inconsistency only; an equal DEM-node bias can still close.
Fewer than three accepted edges yields no redundant cycle; failures are retained and are not silently replaced by another method.

old_pair_policy: retain accepted and rejected records unchanged except index mapping
support: intersection of raw4, all completed new stacks, original RUN13 common support and verified baseline3 stacks
